subcodes.first_line: O Creator of all existence, Fashioner of humanity, and Originator of all contingent beings! Thou art the All-Bountiful, Thou art the All-Merciful [3.5s]... ...one must teach with the utmost wisdom. Should one succeed in illumining a soul through the light of guidance, one should as far as possible conceal his identity
subcodes.first_line_orig: یا بادع الاکوان و بارع الانسان و ذارء الامکان انت المنان انت الرحمن
